verdict.rationale: Weave documents automatic, integration-based instrumentation. Supported LLM integrations such as OpenAI, Anthropic, Cohere and Mistral are traced after `weave.init()`, and the GitHub README says `weave.init()` alone is enough for the OpenAI Agents SDK, Claude Agent SDK and Google ADK. That covers the OpenAI SDK part of the story, but nothing in the pack names LangChain or the Vercel AI SDK, and there is no hands-on corroboration. Missing for 10: evidence of LangChain and Vercel AI SDK integrations, a documented list of framework integrations, independent or hands-on confirmation.

support.subject: As a developer, I can instrument my app through existing integrations for frameworks like LangChain, the OpenAI SDK, or the Vercel AI SDK

citations.quote: When you call weave.init() and use a supported LLM integration such as OpenAI, Anthropic, Cohere, or Mistral, Weave automatically records token usage and calculates cost for each call.
OpenAI Agents SDK, Claude Agent SDK, and Google ADK. `weave.init()` is enough for those SDKs.
